policies.title: Bahrain: GCC citizens do not need an entry visa
policies.summary: The Bahrain National Portal expressly exempts citizens of Kuwait, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Qatar from Bahrain’s entry-visa requirement.
conditions: Applies to citizenship of the five named GCC states, not merely residence in a GCC state.
The National Portal says other nationalities require an entry visa; this is not a visa-on-arrival, ETA, or eVisa.
NPRA separately offers electronic visas to GCC residents who meet its status and document conditions; that route does not alter the named GCC citizen exemption.
Same-flight or same-airport transit is separately visa-free under the Bahrain AIP and is outside this ordinary visitor classification.
Does not classify work, residence, family sponsorship, transit requiring entry, crew, diplomatic, official, service, UN, emergency, refugee, or other special-document entry.

policies.title: Bahrain: citizenship treatment
policies.summary: A Bahraini ordinary passport belongs to a Bahraini citizen and is not a foreign visitor-visa case.
conditions: Applies to Bahraini citizens holding a Bahraini ordinary passport.
Does not decide foreign residence, dual-national document choice, or foreign visitor treatment.
